# Differences between the Paper API the plugin is built against (1.20.1) and other releases that
# were reviewed and are safe. One key per line, as LinkCheck prints it after "DIFF".

# Paper 1.21.3 turned Sound from an enum into an interface. The plugin never calls a method on
# Sound: it only reads its constants (getstatic resolves the same on an interface) and compares
# them with Objects.equals, inside try/catch (bukkit/.../BlockAcoustics.java).
type org/bukkit/Sound

# Adventure in Paper 26.2+ gives TextComponent.Builder.build() a default body instead of leaving it
# abstract. The call is invokeinterface either way, and a default method resolves the same, so the
# clickable link in the addon requirement message (bukkit/.../ChatLink.java) keeps working.
method net/kyori/adventure/text/TextComponent$Builder.build()Lnet/kyori/adventure/text/BuildableComponent;

# Paper 1.21.9+ gives Player.spawnParticle(Particle, x, y, z, count, dx, dy, dz, extra) a default body
# instead of leaving it abstract. The call is invokeinterface either way and a default method resolves
# the same, so zone borders (/vcd zone show, bukkit/.../AudioDistanceBukkit.java) keep working.
method org/bukkit/entity/Player.spawnParticle(Lorg/bukkit/Particle;DDDIDDDD)V

# Paper 1.21.9+ gives Player.getTargetBlockExact(int) a default body instead of leaving it abstract.
# The call is invokeinterface either way and a default method resolves the same, so the block a
# player looks at (/vcd zone pos1 look, bukkit/.../AudioDistanceBukkit.java) keeps working.
method org/bukkit/entity/Player.getTargetBlockExact(I)Lorg/bukkit/block/Block;

# Paper 1.20 has no region schedulers yet (Paper 1.20.1 added them for Folia). The plugin calls them
# only on Folia: FoliaScheduling is created only when Scheduling.isFolia() finds Folia's classes, and
# BukkitThickness asks about regions only when that scheduling is regionized. Folia itself starts
# at 1.20.1, so on Paper 1.20 the plugin uses the Bukkit scheduler (bukkit/.../BukkitScheduling.java).
type io/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/EntityScheduler
type io/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/GlobalRegionScheduler
type io/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/ScheduledTask
type io/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/ScheduledTask$CancelledState
method io/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/EntityScheduler.run(Lorg/bukkit/plugin/Plugin;Ljava/util/function/Consumer;Ljava/lang/Runnable;)Lio/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/ScheduledTask;
method io/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/EntityScheduler.runAtFixedRate(Lorg/bukkit/plugin/Plugin;Ljava/util/function/Consumer;Ljava/lang/Runnable;JJ)Lio/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/ScheduledTask;
method io/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/GlobalRegionScheduler.cancelTasks(Lorg/bukkit/plugin/Plugin;)V
method io/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/GlobalRegionScheduler.runAtFixedRate(Lorg/bukkit/plugin/Plugin;Ljava/util/function/Consumer;JJ)Lio/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/ScheduledTask;
method io/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/ScheduledTask.cancel()Lio/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/ScheduledTask$CancelledState;
method org/bukkit/Bukkit.getGlobalRegionScheduler()Lio/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/GlobalRegionScheduler;
method org/bukkit/Bukkit.isOwnedByCurrentRegion(Lorg/bukkit/Location;)Z
method org/bukkit/Bukkit.isOwnedByCurrentRegion(Lorg/bukkit/entity/Entity;)Z
method org/bukkit/entity/Player.getScheduler()Lio/papermc/paper/threadedregions/scheduler/EntityScheduler;
